purpose: Four distinct region terrain materials plus three region backgrounds; shared Underworld fine pixel craft; runtime light study

jobs.name: regional-kit
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production native pixel-art environment atlas for a Godot metroidvania.

Create a REAL TRANSPARENT sprite sheet, precisely 3 columns x4 rows, twelve separate complete objects with very generous transparent gutters. Each row is a different region, all rendered by the same fine pixel artist. Reference1 supplies the established sprite craft, fine chipped material clusters and fairytale silhouette language. Reference2 supplies the active Underworld-derived terrain: quiet dark interiors, careful local edge detail, native32px tiles. This task must create genuinely DIFFERENT MATERIALS for the regions, not color-swaps. Crisp fine pixel clusters, small controlled palette per material, broken thin highlights, matte surfaces, no thick cream outlines, no uniform gritty noise, no photographic/painterly blur. Neutral restrained diffuse lighting in the base assets; local lighting will be added at runtime. Only the tiny emitter surfaces themselves may be bright, never painted halos. No labels, numbers, frames, grids or floor shadows.

Important column1 contract: a SQUARE 96x96 native-proportion terrain patch, designed as a 3x3 nine-slice tile source. Outer silhouette must be near-square and axis-aligned; flat horizontal top with only a few pixels of relief, straight continuous material sides and bottom with a few chips. Central interior is fully solid opaque material. The nine sections will be mechanically cut at one-third and two-thirds: outer third strips contain edge treatment, center third quiet continuous material. Do not draw any grid lines. No separate hovering prop, grass bush or big rock above terrain. No perspective, no isometric top plane, front cross-section. Bottom corners present, whole patch fits cell. Terrain patches all same square proportions.

ROW1 FOREST:
C1 forest_terrain square: dark umber soil body tightly bound by interlaced ancient root and layered blue-brown bark. A narrow broken green moss/leaf-litter cap on the top only. A few roots crossing down side edges and horizontally under cap; warm exposed wood at breaks. Quiet deep cool-brown core. It must read as root-bound EARTH and WOOD, not recolored blue rock.
C2 forest_detail: isolated buttress root cluster, about85x95 native proportions, tapering twisting roots gripping a small patch of soil, fine moss on its upper shoulder; compatible with the previous forest arch.
C3 forest_lamp: small crooked wooden twig stand holding an amber seed-pod lantern, about36x65 native proportions. Tiny warm pale seed light visibly inside the pod in the upper half, a dark leaf hood, thin branch and rooted foot. No glow outside object.

ROW2 MUSHROOM CAVERNS:
C1 mushroom_terrain square: damp violet-slate rock with layered shelf-like edges, thin muted pale mycelium veins at seams and a narrow soft fungal-mat cap, a few tiny cyan fungal nodes ONLY on the top lip. Very dark plum-grey core, quiet interior, wet blue facets on selected chips. No grass, no brown tree roots, no full neon crack network.
C2 mushroom_landmark: a large asymmetrically leaning double-cap mushroom with a curved stem and branching gill canopy, about200x155 native proportions. Rich muted purple cap tops, finely patterned cyan-turquoise gills on the undersides, a few warm cream filaments. Separate stems root into a small base and leave a beautiful open negative-space arch under the broad caps. Subtle stepped-offset growth gives it one memorable silhouette, no eyes or face. Bright small gill sections are actual emitter material, no halo.
C3 mushroom_lamp: small clump of 3 slender uneven-height lantern mushrooms, about58x62 native proportions, teal-cyan undersides and dull purple caps, delicately tapered stems. The main cap's glowing underside is near upper center.

ROW3 GEAR CITY:
C1 gear_terrain square: heavy aged blue-black riveted iron plating over dark charcoal brickwork. A thin horizontal worn steel walking lip on top, riveted corner brackets, inset narrow pipe grooves at sides, sparse muted bronze oxidation. Clearly rectangular manufactured modules and brick seams, no grass, moss, organic roots, or tiny evenly scattered rivets across every pixel. Preserve quiet core.
C2 gear_landmark: a broken industrial gate made from an incomplete massive cog rim and two weathered iron uprights bolted to brick feet, about200x155 native proportions. Asymmetric missing upper-right teeth; dark desaturated steel and restrained aged bronze details. Open archway, no solid wall across the center. A small recessed amber furnace eye on the right-hand upright around two-thirds height; only its center is emissive.
C3 gear_lamp: slender riveted metal oil-lamp post with a small amber glass chamber and bent pipe hood, about42x70 native proportions, worn blue steel, one small copper valve, foot bracket. Visible amber light core near upper center, no halo.

ROW4 EMBER DEPTHS:
C1 ember_terrain square: near-black cooled basalt and dense lava crust. Strong short angular column joints and horizontal broken cooling layers near edges; top is a dry dark cool-grey rough crust with no grass, a few dull rusty ember seams along lower SIDE edges. Keep most rock cool/black, no yellow-orange all-over cracks and no lava covering walkable top. Clearly volcanic stone, not industrial plates or violet mushroom rock.
C2 ember_landmark: angular fractured basalt rib arch with one tall split shoulder, about200x155 native proportions, dark cool stone planes, stepped hexagonal-column fragments, lower inward faces show restrained cooled rust orange minerals. Broad open center, old solemn volcanic monument, no flames painted over it.
C3 ember_lamp: low isolated broken lava vent rock with small visible glowing orange-red interior fissure facing the viewer, about70x45 native proportions; cold black exterior, a few sharp glassy chips. Small bright warm molten core, no circular glow, smoke or big fire.

All12 objects must be fully inside their cells, with truly transparent backgrounds and holes, and must not touch neighboring cells. Unify rendering fidelity and final pixel density across all4 materials. This is a usable modular kit, not a completed scene.

jobs.name: mushroom-background
jobs.prompt: Asset type: background-only plate for a fine pixel-art 2D metroidvania, intended to be baked to640x360. Generate one wide16:9 landscape image, no text/UI/character/foreground playable terrain or pickups. Match the fine, quiet Underworld-derived family in the references: dark desaturated material masses, selected chipped pixel edges, coherent small clusters, large quiet negative-space areas, no painterly blur or uniform noise. This is a distant/middle background behind independently assembled platforms; keep the bottom third and central corridor clear enough for a44px tall copper-brown hero. No hard black outlines around background objects. Background contrast lower than gameplay sprites. Stage composition: dark framing structures at far sides, deep center opening, atmospheric depth. Lighting should have a credible ambient direction but leave the strong local fixture lights to the runtime, no giant postprocessing bloom. REGION: 蕈灯地穴, a mysterious but inviting bioluminescent mushroom cavern. Huge overlapping muted violet mushroom canopies and gills form a vaulted ceiling, thick tapering mushroom columns at both far sides. In the center a deep dark teal passage with two layers of slender distant stems, a quiet pool of cool mist low in the valley. Sparse tiny cyan fungal gills mark the depth, not fluorescent everywhere. Upper background muted plum and navy, mid-distance teal-grey, isolated pale turquoise accents. A large sagging canopy upper-right has a restrained luminous underside, suggesting where the foreground main mushroom's light belongs. Composition asymmetrical and gentle, a fairy tale with hidden sadness. Avoid generic green forest leaves, stalactite clutter and bright central spotlight. No lava or machinery.
